name: Exp_VolatilityPivot
summary: This EA trades based on the VolatilityPivot custom indicator, which calculates pivot levels using either ATR-based volatility or price deviation. It opens buy/sell positions when the indicator generates directional signals and closes positions on opposite signals or trend reversals, with configurable trade direction (with or against the signal).
summary_zh: 该EA基于VolatilityPivot自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用ATR波动率或价格偏离来计算支点水平。当指标产生方向信号时开仓，在反向信号或趋势反转时平仓，支持顺信号或逆信号交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用VolatilityPivot指标作为核心策略，该指标基于ATR波动率或价格偏离来计算动态支点支撑和阻力水平。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号线出现非空值时做多，下行信号线出现非空值时做空；同时支持逆向交易模式（FalshDirect），即反转信号方向进行交易。出场条件为：当出现反向趋势信号时平仓（如持有多单时出现下行趋势信号则平多），或通过固定的止损止盈出场。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中定义的多种资金管理模式，包括基于可用保证金、账户余额、亏损比例等方式动态计算手数，也可使用固定手数。该策略使用H4作为默认时间框架，属于中长线交易系统，在新K线出现时才重新计算信号，避免了逐tick计算的冗余。止损1000点、止盈2000点的设置表明该策略追求较大的盈亏比。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the VolatilityPivot indicator as its core strategy, which calculates dynamic pivot support and resistance levels based on either ATR volatility or price deviation from a moving average. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's upper signal line produces a non-empty value, and a sell signal is generated when the lower signal line produces a non-empty value; an inverse trading mode (FalshDirect) is also supported to trade against the signal direction. Exit conditions: positions are closed when an opposing trend signal appears (e.g., a long position is closed when a downtrend signal emerges), or via fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing leverages multiple money management modes defined in TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including dynamic lot calculation based on free margin, account balance, or loss proportion relative to the account, as well as a fixed lot option. The strategy uses H4 as the default timeframe, making it a medium-to-long-term trading system that recalculates signals only on new bars, avoiding redundant per-tick computation. The 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit settings indicate the strategy targets a favorable risk-reward ratio of 1:2.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方式（可用保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing method (free margin/balance/loss ratio/fixed lots)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏离点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: Direct
parameters.description: 交易方向（顺信号/逆信号）

parameters.name: IndMode
parameters.description: 指标模式（ATR波动率/价格偏离）

parameters.name: DeltaPrice
parameters.description: 价格偏离值（价格模式下使用）
parameters.description_en: Price deviation value (used in price mode)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 使用波动率支点指标，动态适应市场波动变化，比静态支点更具灵活性
支持多种资金管理模式，可根据账户情况灵活调整仓位大小
新K线才计算信号，减少冗余计算和过度交易风险
提供顺信号和逆信号两种交易方向选择，适应不同市场环境
止损止盈设置合理，盈亏比达到1:2
pros_en: Uses a volatility-based pivot indicator that dynamically adapts to market volatility changes, offering more flexibility than static pivot points
Supports multiple money management modes, allowing flexible position sizing based on account conditions
Recalculates signals only on new bars, reducing redundant computation and overtrading risk
Provides both signal-direction and counter-signal trading modes, adaptable to different market conditions
Reasonable stop loss and take profit settings with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio
cons: 依赖自定义指标VolatilityPivot，指标源码不可见，策略逻辑不透明
未包含点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能产生不利入场
止损1000点设置较大，在高波动市场可能造成较大单笔亏损
没有多时间框架确认机制，仅依赖单一指标信号入场
缺少交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利交易
cons_en: Depends on the custom VolatilityPivot indicator whose source code is not visible, making the strategy logic opaque
Lacks a spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
The 1000-point stop loss is relatively large, which could result in significant per-trade losses in volatile markets
No multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism; relies solely on a single indicator signal for entries
Missing trading session/time filter, potentially generating unfavorable trades during low-liquidity periods
improvements: 增加点差过滤和多时间框架确认，提高入场质量
添加交易时段过滤和动态止损机制，根据ATR调整止损距离
improvements_en: Add a spread filter and multi-timeframe confirmation to improve entry quality
Add trading session filtering and a dynamic ATR-based stop loss mechanism to adjust stop distance according to current volatility

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失时EA无法运行
固定止损点数未根据市场波动率动态调整，高波动时可能频繁止损
无点差过滤，重大新闻或低流动性时段可能导致滑点损失
risk_points_en: Depends on an external custom indicator; the EA cannot run if the indicator is missing
Fixed stop loss in points does not adapt to market volatility dynamically, potentially causing frequent stop-outs during high volatility
No spread filter; major news events or low-liquidity sessions may result in slippage losses
